evidence.interpretation: The official FastVolt Google Play listing links the FastVolt mobile client to an EVPlug-domain support contact while continuing to identify Afri Mobility as the developer/operator identity. This is evidence of a shared technical/support relationship, not evidence that EVPlug is the CPO for FastVolt stations.

do_not_infer: EVPlug as CPO for FastVolt stations
EVOne/EVPlug roaming status as native FastVolt status

significance: Useful client-context evidence for future public/mobile backend discovery: FastVolt and EVPlug have a documented support-layer linkage in the official app listing, but operator/CPO and status-source modeling must remain separate until a native endpoint is validated.
